scope: Actual AUTH/App startup gates; isolated memory only

cases.name: Inactive account is not hidden by the commercial offline gate
Permission rejection blocks stale readiness and its retry is observed
Actual network failure has the requested offline message
Adoption and permission refresh preserve the shell; completion is announced once
Uncertain operation keeps its existing form and confirmation message
Pending confirmation at first load permits a status query without exposing a shell
Changing user discards the prior shell while the new snapshot loads
